steps.title: Prepare tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into small pieces.

steps.title: Pellet tissue and add buffers
steps.instruction: After pelleting the remaining material, remove the supernatant and add Buffer AL and ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Transfer to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting solution to a DNeasy Mini spin column (Qiagen, Hilden, DE) and centrifuge at 8000 rpm.

steps.title: Incubate with elution buffer
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNA bound to the membrane with elution Buffer AE for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Elute DNA by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 1 min to elute the DNA.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fischer Scientific, Darmstadt, DE).
